description: Get product (service) list for billing. Returns available products with their codes, names, descriptions, and categories. Use regionCode and optional filters to narrow results. Paginated (default 50/page, sorted by productCode); the response includes totalRows/returnedRows/hasMore/nextPageNo — follow nextPageNo to page through all results.

pageNo.description: Page number (default 1). Use nextPageNo from the response to page through results.

pageSize.description: Page size (default 50, max 1000). Results are server-sorted by productCode for stable pagination.

productItemKindCode.description: Product item kind code (e.g. VSVR, SW)

productItemKindDetailCode.description: Product item kind detail code (NCP billing classification change, 2026-06-25). Use 'VM' to query VM servers only (otherwise BM may be mixed in), 'BM' for Bare Metal only. Block Storage: BSTAD / BSTBS / BSTBS_BSTAD / CB1 / CB2 / FB1 / FB2.

productName.description: Keyword search (case-insensitive substring). Matches across productName, productDescription, productCode, productType.codeName, productItemKind.codeName — works even when the NCP productName field is empty/Korean (e.g. 'Load Balancer').

regionCode.description: Region code (KR, JPN, SGN, USWN, DEN)

name: ncloud_get_product_list
